ios.desc:
Veloland is your way to turn indoor bike trainer workouts into an exciting, yet demanding adventure, all in retro-inspired virtual world that makes indoor training fun.

** Veloland requires smart bike trainer that supports FTMS. **
** Veloland includes free 3-day demo, after this time a one-time purchase is required to access all features. **

* Retro inspired graphics *
Veloland offers a unique way to train indoors with retro inspired 2D world.

* Route Creator *
Create unlimited, unique routes based on what type of ride you want to have. Flat? Challenging climb? You choose.

* Analyze workouts *
Dive deeper into your performance with ride summaries - averages, charts, HR and Power Zones.

quotes.text:
Hi all,
it's getting cold outside and I'm starting to use my indoor bike trainer more often. I thought it would be fun to build something that I haven't seen yet - a pixel-art 2D game for smart bike trainers. I figured it could be fun to have a low requirements, super simple game instead of more bloated main stream apps that require pricy subscriptions.

It has limited functionality right now but lets players generate unlimited routes based on target distance, elevation and route profile, and very soon a GPX file import.
